title: EEG diagnostic preflight
description: Deterministic synthetic EEG evidence for diagnosis, targeted recovery, fresh retesting, or evidence-bound abort.

apparatus.label: Configurable whole-cap scalp EEG chain
apparatus.scientific_claim: The site positions are schematic interface coordinates, not exact cap geometry.

actions.title: Inspect synthetic EEG traces
actions.description: Inspect the current synthetic multichannel trace window.

actions.title: Inspect frequency evidence
actions.description: Derive frequency measurements from the current displayed synthetic window.

actions.title: Inspect simulated onset route
actions.description: Inspect flash, marker, route, and participant-view evidence.

actions.title: Inspect simulated response path
actions.description: Inspect response occurrence and queried-identity evidence.

actions.title: Inspect simulated recording timeline
actions.description: Inspect recording state and aligned event timestamps.

actions.title: Reseat simulated electrode
actions.description: Reseat one selected simulated Montage electrode.

actions.title: Replace simulated electrode
actions.description: Replace one selected simulated Montage electrode.

actions.title: Reconnect simulated electrode path
actions.description: Reconnect one selected simulated electrode path.

actions.title: Reconnect simulated reference
actions.description: Reconnect the Procedure-selected simulated reference path.

actions.title: Reconnect simulated ground
actions.description: Reconnect the Procedure-selected simulated ground path.

actions.title: Isolate simulated electrical source
actions.description: Isolate the inspected simulated common electrical source.

actions.title: Ask simulated participant to relax
actions.description: Ask the simulated participant to relax and remain still.

actions.title: Repair simulated refractory route
actions.description: Repair the simulated refractory route used by the onset path.

actions.title: Reconnect simulated onset route
actions.description: Reconnect the inspected simulated onset event route.

actions.title: Correct simulated cue visibility
actions.description: Make the simulated lower-right trigger patch unavailable to participant view.

actions.title: Restart simulated response handshake
actions.description: Restart the simulated response-occurrence handshake.

actions.title: Correct simulated response mapping
actions.description: Correct the simulated response identity mapping.

actions.title: Restore simulated recording state
actions.description: Restore the intended simulated acquisition recording state.

actions.title: Realign simulated event integration
actions.description: Restart the simulated integration to collect a coherent event timeline.

actions.title: Collect fresh synthetic EEG window
actions.description: Collect a fresh comparative multichannel display window.

actions.title: Present fresh synthetic test flash
actions.description: Present one fresh synthetic lower-right test flash.

actions.title: Run fresh simulated response preflight
actions.description: Record a fresh simulated response occurrence and identity check.

actions.title: Run fresh simulated recording preflight
actions.description: Record a fresh simulated recording-state and timeline check.

actions.title: Submit preflight for verification
actions.description: Submit the current Policy-visible evidence for deterministic verification.

actions.title: Abort simulated preflight with evidence
actions.description: Stop the simulated preflight and cite current evidence for a blocking path.
